notes.title: 💀 💥 Art Trade
notes.content:
[b]Super Skull Smash GO! 2 Turbo[/b] will be available to be paid for by art instead of cash. We know that not everyone has the cash available to purchase a game, or sometimes they lack the method to pay digitally. If you send us a fan work based on [b]Super Skull Smash GO! 2 Turbo[/b] , we'll send you a free key for the game on Steam. This is an experimental program, and can be discontinued at any time.

Rules:
[list]
   [*]The art must be original and use no copied elements, including graphics taken directly from the game.
   [*]It needs to have taken you at least half an hour. It’s okay if you’re not good, but we’d like to you to have spent a little time on it.
   [*]Can be visual art of any kind. Drawing, 3D model, etc
   [*]Has to be about the game in some way.
   [*]Include the name of the game somewhere in the work.
   [*]The artist is ok with us posting their artwork on social media. We will credit you however you wish. Artwork will be featured on the Steam Community hub.
   [*]Limit one per person.
   [*]Art can be submitted via Twitter by mentioning [url=https://twitter.com/WorkWithPoppy/]@WorkWithPoppy[/url] or by sending it to us at Hello@poppy.works
   [*]Optional: If you do post it on a social media, please provide a link to the game in the Steam Store! This is optional, but we really appreciate it!
[/list]

This option is for those who cannot afford to buy the game normally. Please be respectful, and have fun!

-Poppy Works

notes.title: Version 1.5 now available.
notes.content:
- Stability improvements made to boss rooms.
- An "Exit" button has been added to the main menu for PC and Mac OSX users.
- Analog movement on Map Screen has been improved.
- The subpixel rendering error on some platforms has been fixed. Special thanks to YellowAfterLife and MobiDevelop on GitHub.
- Transitioning into game from boot is now smoother on PlayStation.
- 「Steam Achievements」の日本語テキストが更新されました。


These and other improvements will be available on PS4 and PS Vita in the near future.

[i]Poppy Works[/i]
